workload: grown no-op fetched sync_all, 5 Items, 35,619 retained raw+normalized rows, local PG16 loopback
limitations: Sleep in before_cursor_execute blocks the event loop and approximates serial round trips only; no TLS, Supavisor, CPU contention, bank latency or cold start. Projection is linear in retained rows and assumes ~2 queries per retained row. Baseline 49.6 s is a cold-cache restart; earlier warm median was 40.5 s.
growth_assumption: ~1,300 retained rows/year: rough estimate from 2,610 rows over the ~730-day backfill, not a measured Production growth rate

interpretation.evidence_class: local injected-latency sensitivity test; not evidence of actual Vercel-to-Supabase performance
interpretation.current_workload: ~2,610 retained rows has substantial modeled headroom (~9-30 s no-op cycle at 1-5 ms)
interpretation.query_amplification: ~2.0 statements per retained row on every cycle including no-op; approximately linear with retained history; remains an architectural risk
interpretation.application_deadline: MAX_RUN_SECONDS=300 is not acceptable at a 300 s platform hard limit; unchanged for now
interpretation.deadline_candidate: ~240 s bounded deadline is a candidate only, pending validation of actual cloud cancellation/termination/finalization/unlock
interpretation.next_decisive_measurement: actual Vercel-to-Supabase DB round-trip latency and total sync_all wall time on the disposable synthetic cloud environment
